card.name: Spanish and Indonesian text, non-English
card.fires_on: Spanish or Indonesian words in non-English passages: pieces inside Spanish words in web addresses, and sentence-ending periods in Spanish text. It also fires inside some Indonesian words.

modes.label: Inside Spanish URL words
modes.description: Word pieces inside Spanish words in hyphenated web addresses about a maritime border dispute.

modes.label: Period in Spanish sentences
modes.description: The full stop ending a Spanish sentence, just before the next Spanish sentence begins.
modes.example: Agite 10 veces antes de usarlo<<.>> Aplique directamente bajo la leng

modes.label: Indonesian word pieces
modes.description: Partway through Indonesian words in non-English web text.
modes.example: BUKU INI DI TULIS PADA TAHUN 1869 OLEH SEORANG MUBAL<<IGH>> AMERIKA YANG MERANC

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses Chinese measure words and Portuguese, Romanian and Vietnamese words, and promotes a few English words like either and rather.
card.plain: It marks text that is in Spanish or Indonesian rather than English, especially Spanish web addresses and sentence ends.
